description.p: TubeRip is a desktop application for downloading YouTube videos in high quality or extracting audio in your preferred format. It features a clean interface with a live download queue, pause and resume support, customizable quality presets, subtitle embedding, and a folder browser for your save location.
Simply paste a YouTube URL or video ID, choose between video (MP4, MKV, WEBM) or audio (MP3, M4A, OPUS) extraction, pick a quality preset, and click download.
